messages.subject_clean: Mentors: time to review student applications
messages.body_plain:
Hi all, I just added all the mentors listed on our wiki to the summerofcode.withgoogle.com <http://summerofcode.withgoogle.com> web site, so please log on and start reviewing the applications we received.
Also please email me if you would like an invite to participate as a mentor.
Thanks
Toby

messages.body_plain:
It looks like the web interface has changed since last year, and there is no longer a comment box where you can write your comments about the proposal.
But you can still click "want to mentor" on the proposal, so please do that.
It would be great if you can also email the org admins listed below to tell us your preferences about which proposal(s) you would like to mentor, and which you would prefer to reject.
Vijay Barve <vijay...@gmail.com>, Narayani Barve <naray...@gmail.com>, "Brian G. Peterson" <br...@braverock.com>, Toby Dylan Hocking <Toby.H...@r-project.org>

messages.subject: Re: Mentors: time to review student applications
messages.subject_clean: Mentors: time to review student applications
messages.body_plain:
Greetings!

I was wondering if you would like another mentor for the RcppDeepState project, as I am interested in looking after that (provided or assuming that project is selected).

Having dealt <https://anirban166.github.io//Automation/> with GitHub Actions (ironically, for last year's GSoC project!) for a decent amount of time, I can help in the area of workflow automation, along with the other technologies involved in the project (such as R and C++), given they are ones I'm well familiar with.

Also, I'm currently researching and working on applying DeepState <https://github.com/trailofbits/deepstate> to NASA's F' or fprime <https://github.com/nasa/fprime> open-source software by building a test harness (test drivers and stubs/boilerplate, with my current focus being command generation) for it. Thus, this seemed pretty relevant to my work for the summer (given that DeepState is a core part of it), and I will be more than happy to mentor this project for a selected student if possible or required.

Best regards,
Anirban
